title: Connected Histories
summary: In the spring of 2022, the Institute of Contemporary History at the University of Innsbruck and the Vienna Wiesenthal Institute for Holocaust Studies invited to the first international EHRI-AT conference “#connectedhistories: Memories and Narratives of the Holocaust in Digital Space”. At the center of this collection of essays is the digital space as an arbitrary and limitless archive for the mediation of the Holocaust.
